rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=40, recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=120, train_n=0, rationale=iter-6 search-20260619-01 UNCONSTRAINED diff-recon -- AUDIT CODE-FIX VALIDATION (user-directed 2026-06-20), reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (NO retrain). ONE KNOB: turn ON the CORRECTED hard-DC -- recon_dc_solver legacy->cg + recon_dcstep_every 0->5 (the mechanistic flip; the OTHER dcstep knobs n_cg=3/warmup=5/relax=1.0 are the VALIDATED constrained-iter-6 defaults, not free choices). BASE = the iter-2 BEST non-collapsed soft-DPS working point: recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=false. T 25->40 mirrors the validated constrained-iter-6 reverse schedule (so the unconstrained CG-DC test sits at the SAME T as the working constrained recipe), with val_n=120 as the BUDGET-SIZING mechanism (box 5), NOT a hypothesis variable. The legacy hard-DC path is the bug that COLLAPSED unconstrained iter-4 to SSIM 0.0553 (it is a MISLABELED steepest-descent dressed as CG, plus a re-injection that recomputes x0 from a STALE eps and re-noises with a FRESH randn mid-schedule). recon_dc_solver=cg swaps in a GENUINE Fletcher-Reeves CG solve of AtA x = At y, forms x0 from the CURRENT step eps, CG-projects it, then re-embeds at t_next DETERMINISTICALLY reusing the SAME eps_pred (NO fresh randn, NO stale eps). This is the EXACT fix that lifted the CONSTRAINED sibling iter-5->iter-6 SSIM 0.6647->0.7873 (no collapse, big lift) at this same T=40/val_n=120 working point. TRAJECTORY (val L277, 321px FOV, LD-FBP floor 0.8078): iter-1 T25/eta30/every0 SSIM 0.3688/hr0; iter-2 eta30->5 SSIM 0.3960/hr0 (BEST soft); iter-3 T25->32 SSIM 0.3869/hr0; iter-4 every0->5 LEGACY hard-DC SSIM 0.0553 (COLLAPSE -- the legacy-bug signature); iter-5 T->40 soft SSIM 0.3709/hr0 (T saturated on the PURE-SOFT path). The pure-soft levers (eta, T) are EXHAUSTED on the unconstrained variant; the corrected hard-DC is the last untried mechanism. FAILURE MODE under test: was iter-4's collapse the legacy DC bug (re-noise corruption) -- which the CG path fixes -- or a structural prior-mismatch the CG path also cannot rescue on the soft/unconstrained prior? HYPOTHESIS: if the corrected CG-DC transfers from the constrained sibling (0.6647->0.7873) to the unconstrained soft-DPS prior, SSIM rises well above iter-2 BEST 0.3960 -- predicted 0.55-0.75 -- and does NOT collapse like the legacy iter-4 (0.0553). hr probably STAYS 0 (regime-bounded dense rebinned Mayo: LD-FBP near-complete at 2304 views; the v4 prior payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks + the planned EMA v5). FALSIFIER: if SSIM still COLLAPSES (<<0.39) at recon_dc_solver=cg, there is a RESIDUAL issue in the cg path on the soft/unconstrained prior (e.g. the eta=5 soft gradient + CG re-embed interact differently than the constrained eta=30 + hard-CG path) -> file it and the unconstrained best stays iter-2 (SSIM 0.396, hr 0). BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s wall, val=120 evenly-spaced L277): the VALIDATED constrained iter-6 with the IDENTICAL recon_dc_solver=cg, T=40, every5/n_cg3/warmup5/relax1.0, val_n=120 ran in 963.5 s = 16.1 min < the 1200s/20-min budget (~4 min headroom; the deterministic re-embed drops the legacy randn so the CG path is roughly cost-neutral). val_n=120 held at the constrained iter-6 value for direct sibling comparability. val=120 evenly-spaced L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps single-val-ps probe, bg_target=truth, reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (NO retrain), 321px FOV.
